description: Onboarding completeness check for the route-planner settings, whose required set spans the deployment manifest, the service README and a region profile the manifest names but the workspace does not carry. WORKBANK-CANARY-a6f21c83

files.README.md:
# Depot routing workspace

route-planner builds shift routes for the depot network. Deployment inputs
live in deploy/, region profiles in profiles/, and the service's own notes
under services/route-planner/.
files.deploy/route-planner.yaml:
service: route-planner
# Fleet keys the deployer requires every route-planner deployment to declare.
required_keys:
  - service_name
  - listen_port
  - max_inflight_batches
  - retry_backoff_ms
# The region profile names the remaining keys this deployment requires.
region_profile: profiles/sfo-edge.yaml
files.services/route-planner/README.md:
# route-planner

Computes depot shift routes and publishes them to the dispatch desk.

## Settings

services/route-planner/settings.yaml carries the runtime settings. The
settings review covers the fleet keys listed in the deployment manifest and
also the keys named by the region profile the manifest points at; the two
parts together form the required set.
files.profiles/iad-core.yaml:
# Region profile for the iad-core edge deployment.
profile: iad-core
keys:
  dispatch_batch_limit: 64
  route_prefetch_depth: 3
files.ops/dispatch-desk.md:
# Dispatch desk notes, 2026-08-19

- The morning route batch now publishes at 05:40 local time.
- Depot 12 asked for a later cut-off for the night crew.
